title: Replace Haridwar Ayurveda logo asset and update header/footer references

requirements.summary: Add a new updated Haridwar Ayurveda logo image as an additional static asset without altering the existing logo file.
acceptanceCriteria: A new logo image file exists in frontend/public/assets/generated with a distinct filename from the current logo.
The existing file /assets/generated/haridwar-ayurveda-logo.dim_512x512.png is not removed or overwritten.

file_operations.description: Add the refreshed logo design as a new static asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/haridwar-ayurveda-logo-v2.dim_512x512.png, keeping the existing frontend/public/assets/generated/haridwar-ayurveda-logo.dim_512x512.png intact (do not overwrite or delete).

requirements.summary: Update landing page branding so Header and Footer use the new logo asset while preserving sizing, layout, and English alt text.
acceptanceCriteria: Header logo image src no longer points to /assets/generated/haridwar-ayurveda-logo.dim_512x512.png and instead points to the new logo filename.
Footer logo image src no longer points to /assets/generated/haridwar-ayurveda-logo.dim_512x512.png and instead points to the new logo filename.
Logo sizing and layout remain consistent (no broken layout, image loads successfully).
Logo alt text remains in English and continues to describe the brand (e.g., "Haridwar Ayurveda").

file_operations.description: Update the header logo src to reference /assets/generated/haridwar-ayurveda-logo-v2.dim_512x512.png instead of /assets/generated/haridwar-ayurveda-logo.dim_512x512.png, keeping existing sizing/classes and the English alt text (e.g., "Haridwar Ayurveda").

Update the footer brand logo src to reference /assets/generated/haridwar-ayurveda-logo-v2.dim_512x512.png instead of /assets/generated/haridwar-ayurveda-logo.dim_512x512.png, keeping existing sizing/classes and the English alt text (e.g., "Haridwar Ayurveda").
